body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range after your movement.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Move up to 2 units. On success, deal 1 weapon Damage.

surges.html: Ignore difficult terrain during this movement.
On a hit, move 2 units away from the target without triggering its movement Reactions.

rider.title: Combo - Blitz
rider.html: Spend 1 Combo after resolving to gain +1 Fortitude against the target until the start of your next turn, provided you are no longer adjacent to it.
